About The Selma Lagerlöf Archive

The Selma Lagerlöf Archive contains all of her works of fiction published as books during her lifetime. Some books are also available in facsimiles. Two of these works, Gösta Berling's Saga and Invisible Links are also available as e-texts in critical editions, with commentaries, annotations and a critical apparatus in a text criticism workshop. Other works can be studied as e-texts which are proofread against the original edition. In the archive there are also facsimiles of manuscripts and new and older research on the authorship.
